resources.string: A calm, offline-first home for your tasks, projects, notes, goals and focus sessions. This is the foundation screen for Phase 0 — the structure is in place, the modules arrive next.
Planned modules. None of them are functional yet.
Offline-first. No account, no tracking, no network permission.
ORBIT is a personal command center for Android. It is designed to be private by default: your data stays on your device, and nothing is sent anywhere unless you explicitly ask for it.
Every core feature is built to work with no network connection. The Phase 0 build does not request any permission at all.
Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3 and an MVVM architecture, on a Gradle Kotlin DSL build with JDK 17.
